verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Each drop counting something
I've stopped keeping track of—
the gutter answers anyway.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a robin tests the downspout's silence,
finds it hollow enough to nest in—
spring counts by other means

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the empty pipe fills
with something feathered, small—
I forget what I was measuring

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a shell, a wingbeat, the pipe's throat singing—
whatever I meant to add up
is already flying

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Not sure I meant "sum" at all—
just the nest, the light through it,
this counting that keeps no total

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the light through it lands on my hands now—
whatever I was counting
has started counting me

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I put my hands down, empty—
still the tally continues somewhere,
a nest of numbers I didn't build

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the wind takes up the tally now—
each number a feather loosed
and never asked to return

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
no return address either—
just this open hand catching
whatever number lands

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the sky keeps sending mail—
no words on any of it,
just weight, then wings, then gone

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I read that weightless mail all morning—
what I owe no one
still arrives, still leaves

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the debt collector's no one—
so I pay in open palms,
in letting each envelope fly

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
palm lines forget the amounts—
only the wind keeps ledgers now,
and it never once collects

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the wind's ledger blows open—
every page a blank field
where something was owed

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
blank fields hold the plow's old path—
I walk it anyway,
owing the ground nothing but my steps
